Solar Words, Straight #1: true-up. The word installers say fast, and why it matters for the credits you earn. Sources on the last slide.

Follow for more plain-English Oʻahu solar math.

#Oahu #HawaiiSolar #SolarPower #HawaiianElectric #Honolulu

slides.text: Your installer said “true-up.” Here's what it can cost you.
True-up = the yearly reset on your solar credits.
slides.sub: Once a year, your account gets squared up.

slides.text: All year, extra solar earns credits on your bill.
slides.sub: Credits you don't use roll forward to next month.

slides.text: At the true-up, credits you never used expire.
slides.sub: You don't get paid out for them.
“How many credits will I bank a year, and how many will expire at true-up?”

slides.text: Follow for straight answers on Oʻahu solar.

items: Hawaiian Electric Rule 32 (Smart Renewable Energy Export): credits roll forward month to month; unused credits expire after 12 months.
